reviews.shade: COSRX Oil Free Ultra Moisturizing Lotion 100 mL
reviews.text:
I’ve been really impressed with this moisturiser 
It’s lightweight, absorbs quickly, and provides great hydration without feeling greasy or heavy. I have combination skin, and it keeps my skin moisturized throughout the day without making it oily or causing breakouts.
I highly recommend this.
Me encantaaa
reviews.zh:
我對呢款保濕霜印象非常好
質地輕盈，吸收快，提供出色保濕又唔會覺得油笠或厚重。我係混合性肌，用成日皮膚都保持到保濕，但又唔會變油或爆瘡。
非常推薦。
Me encantaaa

reviews.shade: COSRX Oil Free Ultra Moisturizing Lotion 100 mL
reviews.text: An incredible oil-free lotion that delivers deep hydration without any heaviness or greasy residue. The birch sap formula feels extremely lightweight, soothing, and refreshing on the skin, making it an absolute must-have for oily and acne-prone types.
reviews.zh: 一支令人驚喜嘅無油乳液，提供深層保濕又唔會有任何厚重感或油膩殘留。白樺樹液配方用喺皮膚上感覺非常輕盈、舒緩、清爽，絕對係油性同暗瘡肌嘅必備品。

reviews.shade: COSRX Oil Free Ultra Moisturizing Lotion 100 mL
reviews.text: I decided to try this product on recommendation. Not a bad light texture. Absorbs quickly. Doesn't leave a greasy shine. Moisturizes the skin quite well. But I don't like the smell. It's somehow chemically unpleasant. It's good that it evaporates after a couple of minutes and I don't feel it. But it took me a long time to come to terms with this smell and apply it to my face.
reviews.zh: 我聽人介紹先試呢款產品。質地輕薄唔差。吸收快。唔會留低油光。保濕效果都幾好。但係我唔鍾意個味道，聞落有種化學嘅令人唔舒服嘅感覺。好彩幾分鐘後就散晒，我聞唔到。但係我要用好耐時間先接受到呢個味道，肯搽上面。

reviews.shade: COSRX Oil Free Ultra Moisturizing Lotion 100 mL
reviews.text: Light weigh moisturizing, is great for oily- prone skin. I like to use this at my morning routine since absorbs faster and gave me enought hydratation for the day. But in my case I see this as a no necessary step in my routine, I have other products that hidrátate much better, like the Snail Mucin, I recomend to alternate the product and not using the at the same routine.
reviews.zh: 質地輕盈保濕，啱油性肌。我鍾意喺早上護膚程序用，因為吸收快，可以為成日提供足夠保濕。但係以我嘅情況嚟講，我覺得呢個步驟唔係必要嘅，我有其他保濕效果好得多嘅產品，好似 Snail Mucin，我建議輪住用，唔好同一個程序一齊用。

reviews.shade: COSRX Oil Free Ultra Moisturizing Lotion 100 mL
reviews.text: bought this bc i was running out of my old moisturizer that is no longer being sold. i’ve been using it for about a week now and it doesn’t leave me skin feeling greasy and keeps it moisturized. a little goes a long way - one pump covers my entire face. there is a subtle smell to it when you first put it on but then once you rub it in, you don’t smell it
reviews.zh: 買呢支係因為舊嗰支保濕霜用晒，而且已經停產。用咗大概一個星期，皮膚唔會覺得油笠，而且保持到保濕。少量就夠用——一下唧就可以塗勻成塊面。最初搽上去會有少少味道，但搽開之後就聞唔到。

reviews.shade: COSRX Oil Free Ultra Moisturizing Lotion 100 mL
reviews.text: Não sei sobre este. Usei uma vez junto com minha rotina atual, apenas substitui o hidratante de própolis por este e acordei com acne. Tive um pequeno breakout. Não sei, preciso usar sob outras condições e observar sua performance...
reviews.zh: 我唔知點講呢支。用咗一次配合我現有嘅程序，只係將蜂膠保濕霜換成呢支，瞓醒就生暗瘡。有少少爆瘡。唔知點，要喺其他情況下再用吓睇下表現……

reviews.shade: COSRX Oil Free Ultra Moisturizing Lotion 100 mL
reviews.text: This is my all the time favourite moisturizer from cosrx! Just like the moisturizing og pads, i cannot live without this! Its very moisturizing and feels so good on the skin! It is oil free and scent free! Altho i loved the original formulation of this product which has a medicinal type of scent to it, i still love this!
reviews.zh: 呢個係我長期以嚟最鍾意嘅 cosrx 保濕霜！就好似保濕 og 棉片一樣，冇咗佢我都唔得！非常保濕，搽喺皮膚上感覺好好！無油無味！雖然我鍾意原本有種藥水味嘅配方，但我依然好鍾意呢支！

reviews.shade: COSRX Oil Free Ultra Moisturizing Lotion 100 mL
reviews.text: The Oil-Free Ultra-Moisturizing Lotion has a gel/cream consistency. It looks somewhat like lotion or an emulsion but it is a little bit more consistent than that. Once you start spreading it on your skin, the consistency turns into a watery gel and it delivers that cooling sensation and glowy/wet look we all strive to have. i love Cosrx products!
reviews.zh: Oil-Free Ultra-Moisturizing Lotion 係 gel/cream 質地。睇落有少少似乳液或乳化液，但稠度比嗰啲多少少。當你開始喺皮膚上推開，質地會變成水感 gel，帶嚟清涼感同大家都想要嘅水潤光澤。我鍾意 Cosrx 嘅產品！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
